question: For the station that had the highest number of Citibike trips starting there in 2018, which numeric day of the week and which hour of the day had the greatest number of trips based on the start time of those trips?
sql:
SELECT 
  (SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime) 
   FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
   WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
     AND starttime IS NOT NULL
     AND start_station_id = 519
   GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime)
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
   LIMIT 1) as day_of_week,
  (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime)
   FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
   WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
     AND starttime IS NOT NULL
     AND start_station_id = 519
   GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime)
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
   LIMIT 1) as hour_of_day
